question: What were the total incurred losses on home claims in Q3 2026?

report.interpretation: Total incurred losses (paid to date plus open reserves) on home claims, counted by loss date from 2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30, using the agreed incurred_losses metric.
report.answer: Home incurred losses for Q3 2026 were about $9.47M ($9,474,779.72). Late-reported claims (especially liability) are still missing from the last few weeks of September, so this figure will probably rise.
report.answer_sql: SELECT sum(coalesce(pay.paid,0)+c.reserve_amount) AS incurred_losses FROM claims c LEFT JOIN (SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id) pay USING (claim_id) WHERE c.product='home' AND c.loss_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30'

tool_calls.sql:
WITH source AS (
    SELECT c.*, p.channel, p.metro,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) AS paid_to_date,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) + c.reserve_amount AS incurred,
           c.close_date - c.report_date AS days_to_close
    FROM claims c
    JOIN policies p USING (policy_id)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) AS paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id
    ) pay USING (claim_id)
)
SELECT sum(incurred) AS value
FROM source
WHERE loss_date >= DATE '2026-07-01'
  AND loss_date <= DATE '2026-09-30'
  AND product IN ('home')
